note: P is mostly 2D side-view 32x32 grids (P1, P3, P4, with differing skies, textures, and seeded terrain) plus one isometric 3D heightmap (P2), so it has one real outlier; Q is four flat 32x32 paint grids with a swatch toolbar (Q3 sidebar and Q4 pre-filled ground are minor changes) and R is likewise four flat grids with different toolbars (R3 adds stackable column height, R4 adds quadrant guides), so both repeat one design. No design breaks the 32x32 sandbox, add/remove, simple or unnamed constraints.
